items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: Of course, I never played with him on parade. But, I mean, all the other guys had the same acclamation as a parade man that I had for him as an orchestra man.

ctx.x: Oh, he was the master of the parade. Of course, I never played with him on parade. But, I mean, all the other guys had the same acclamation as a parade man that I had for him as an orchestra man.
Was he a bass drum on parade?
